_comment: Research tree paid with Éclats (Managers/Stasis/Ascension.cs reads this). A character's ranks are permanent: an Ascension and an Evolution keep them. costs[i] is the price of rank i+1, so maxRank is the length of costs. kind: catchUp (+perRank to the experience multiplier after an Ascension, on top of ascension.json catchUpBase), cards (+perRank card in every offer but the class passives), freeRerolls (+perRank free reroll each Ascension cycle), repicks (+perRank characteristic re-pick each cycle), caracAmount (+perRank to the characteristic card), eclats (+perRank percent of Éclats earned by an Ascension), stat (+perRank of the named characteristic, always on).
